en.headline: HKMA and Bank Indonesia sign MoU on QR code cross-border payments
en.dek: The Hong Kong Monetary Authority and Bank Indonesia agreed to explore technical, operational and regulatory arrangements for interoperable QR payments between the two places.
body: The Hong Kong Monetary Authority and Bank Indonesia signed a memorandum of understanding on Thursday to strengthen cooperation on Quick Response code-based cross-border payments.

The HKMA said the two central banks seek to promote faster, more affordable, transparent and inclusive payments between Hong Kong and Indonesia. Under the MoU they will hold dialogues on technical, operational and regulatory matters and explore arrangements to facilitate interoperability of QR code payments.

The agreement forms part of ongoing efforts to deepen bilateral financial ties. Both authorities emphasised building effective cooperation mechanisms that support the growing economic and people-to-people links between the two jurisdictions.

zh.headline: 金管局與印尼央行簽備忘錄 加強二維碼跨境支付合作
zh.dek: 香港金融管理局與印尼中央銀行今日簽署合作備忘錄，將就技術、營運及監管事宜展開對話，探討促進兩地二維碼跨境支付互聯互通。
body: 香港金融管理局與印尼中央銀行今日簽署合作備忘錄，加強雙方在二維碼跨境支付方面的合作。
金管局表示，雙方致力加強雙邊關係，並建立有效的合作機制，促進香港與印尼之間更快捷、便宜、透明及普惠的跨境支付。根據備忘錄，雙方將就有關技術、營運及監管事宜展開對話，並探討促進兩地二維碼跨境支付互聯互通的安排。
金管局指出，有關合作有助進一步深化兩地金融聯繫，配合日益密切的經貿及民間往來。
